summary.note: total_rows counts one row per (export file x entity); distinct_entities is how many entities are actually set aside. A refused entity may still be present in this catalog by another route -- a refusal records that an import declined it, not that the entity is missing. This ledger is a UNION across sync cycles: a refusal recorded by any host on any cycle is preserved, because a wholesale rewrite silently deleted 4,329 historical rows on 2026-08-28 (caught by codexreview 20260831T095127Z, finding 1).
